name: .NET / C# with ASP.NET Core and external persistence adapters
implemented_controls: Roslyn syntax checks for configured Domain/Application namespace and type dependencies
Literal direct/transitive project references and explicit package/framework/assembly dependency checks
Fail-closed source/configuration/project discovery, syntax and unresolved conditional-source checks
Isolated synthetic regression executable and real CLI exit-code tests with verified temporary cleanup

validation.environment: Windows; .NET SDK 8.0.413 selected by global.json; .NET 8 runtime; PowerShell 7.6.5; SDK-bundled Roslyn; offline NuGet sources
validation.result: 2026-10-16: nested-namespace bypass reproduced before correction (42 scenarios, one expected failure). After composing enclosing namespace blocks, build passed with zero warnings/errors; 48 scenarios passed with zero failures, including five real CLI scenarios and permitted/forbidden dotted, nested and multi-segment namespace cases. All 48 synthetic fixtures and temporary build/restore/CLI-home directories were removed and verified. No bin/obj/artifacts or owned temporary directories remained.
limitations: Only package controls are tested; no destination application, database, identity provider or payment service was exercised.
GitHub CI and Linux execution were not run.
Source inspection is not semantic analysis or full evaluated MSBuild/NuGet dependency resolution; generated code, imported props/targets, reflection and dynamic behavior require additional checks.
Inactive conditional source is rejected rather than certified; build-aware verification is required for such projects.
The destination must implement and verify all seven project gates, including architecture beyond this bounded scanner.
